adjudication.rationale: The diff at line 314-316 shows: `const calendarId = externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;`. When `externalCalendarId` is falsy (absent), the code searches for a calendar where `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` (i.e., where externalId equals undefined/null), which will never match any valid calendar entry. This means it will always return undefined and fall back to `defaultCalendarId` ('primary') at line 322, rather than using the actual configured destination calendar. This is a logic bug - the find condition should use a different criterion (like credentialId) when externalCalendarId is not provided, similar to how createEvent handles it.
